TEXT: *Blizzard has just stepped paws into a foster care home* Blizzard is a handsome blue fawn, confident, happy boy who loves people. This absolute goofball sure does love toys, too. Blizzard is a very playful, boy both with handler and by himself and is happy to entertain himself for periods of time alone on his own. He loves treats and does amazingly in training sessions, already showing great skills as he knows ‘down’ and ‘on your bed’, also plays fetch! A home without stairs is the best match for him, as well as a house with some sort of backyard/townhouse yard. Affectionate isn't even a word for this boy, he leans into ear scratches and groans like it’s the best thing ever. With all this personality, he can be energetic and bouncy, so a home without kids is best. A dog friend who is tolerant of his playful ways would be a great fit. Blizzard is at the Western Sydney adoption centre!

NAME: Julie
TEXT: Miss Julie is a playful, friendly girl who loves her toys, a run around with the other dogs (retired greyhounds and Jug), a splash in her clam shell pool and just being around people and quiet kids 10+, not too rambunctious. She's a bit of a character, loves to show off but she's not over the top, just a happy girl! At 6 she hasn't lost energy but slows down faster and rests longer, especially as she is learning the comforts of retired life! Julie has grown up on the farm and has come into town life ready for her new home. She has taken to a nice cosy bed on the floor and loves being on the patio as well on the warm nights. She would suit a quiet household, and someone with the time to get to know her, take her for a walk and have a bit of playtime in the morning, especially if you are going off to work. Some toys, an outdoor bed, pool, sandpit or another dog friend will keep her company for the day, plus plenty of rests. Someone home more often than not would be perfect. She's easy going and not worried by pet birds, cats or little fluffy dogs. Just a sweetheart ready to relish retired life. 💗

NAME: Sherman
TEXT: Meet Sherman. Mr. Personality Plus Pup! What a beautiful friendly young lad, still a goofy puppy but has an easy going and laid back nature, a little shy at first but very friendly once he's met you. He loves being out and about, going to the vet and travelling in the car. He just loves the kids 7 and 11 years old, still learning not to jump up when he gets excited seeing them, and loves to go on walks with them. He is very good on the lead. Sherman is respectful of the household cat and is not quite sure what to make of the Maltese but just follows him around anyway! Very curious and inquisitive. Sherman loves playtime, pats, walks and new adventures. He's still learning about life and is best suited to an experienced dog/greyhound owner to continue his education, positive experiences and guidance to continue being the beautiful, loveable companion he is into adulthood. What a journey ad privilege to have the chance to grow with him. 🐾🐾

NAME: Bozo
TEXT: Bozo is a tall, shy, and gentle boy. He might be big and tall but he has a quiet, soft and wise personality. If you're looking for a very gentle giant, who loves to lean on you and look up at you with puppy dog eyes, Bozo is the perfect match. Bozo is such a gentleman, especially around other dogs. He is a calm, reserved boy who would suit a home who can build up his confidence. A quiet, understanding owner who is interested in helping shy dogs become the best confident version of themselves, would be the perfect fit for our gentle giant, Bozo. Come and meet him at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Skinney
TEXT: Hi, I'm Skinney, I'm a cute young boy with cute markings! I walk nicely on the lead and can be shy when I first meet you. I promise I'll be your new best friend once we get to know eachother! As for what my perfect forever home looks like, I'd love a kind and gentle home, just like me. Maybe some older kids to throw ball, and a small yard to call my own? I could also live with a gentle likeminded doggie friend the same size as me. I'm a really sweet gentle boy, come and meet me at the Western Sydney adoption centre!

NAME: Liv
TEXT: Liv is a beautiful senior greyhound, she is a quiet, gentle soul who radiates calm and kindness, and she’s looking for a peaceful home where she can spend her golden years surrounded by love. Liv still has a sparkle in her eye and plenty of energy for playtime. She adores gentle pats, slow strolls, and curling up beside her humans for quiet companionship. Liv is the kind of dog who will rest her head on your lap and make you feel like the most important person in the world.

NAME: Banjo
TEXT: Banjo is a beautiful older gentleman with a sprinkle of grey wisdom on his cute face. At nearly 8 years old, Banjo may be entering his golden years, but don’t let that fool you—he’s still full of life, love, and the occasional burst of playful energy. He’s a sweet, affectionate boy who adores human company and thrives on gentle attention. Banjo is happiest when he’s curled up beside you, soaking in the quiet moments, or going on a leisurely walk. Banjo is calm, well-mannered and is looking for a loving home where he can enjoy the simple pleasures: a soft bed, a warm lap, and a family to call his own.

NAME: Owen
TEXT: Ohh - it's OWEN! Owen is a calm and sweet boy, gentle and confident boy. He is soft and loving around other dogs including small dogs and would be happy to join a multi-dog household. This lovely gentle lad is all things laid back - non jumpy, calm and soft natured. Owen would prefer a townhouse/courtyard to call his own and would suit many home types due to his absolutely lovely personality! Available at Western Sydney Londonderry adoption centre!

NAME: Stories
TEXT: Meet Stories 🐾 💕 Say hello to Stories, a sweet and affectionate girl who's ready to begin her next chapter—with you! This friendly lady is a total social butterfly who gets along beautifully with both dogs and cats. She’s always happy to make new friends and brings a gentle, joyful energy wherever she goes. Stories loves her toys 🎾, adores her treats 🍖, and soaks up affection like sunshine ☀️. Whether she’s having a play session or just leaning in for cuddles, she’s happiest when she’s close to her humans. If you’re looking for a loving companion who’s good with all creatures and full of fun and affection, Stories could be the perfect addition to your family. Let her bring some love—and a few tail wags—into your life!

NAME: Daisy
TEXT: Meet Daisy 🌸🐾 She is a gentle and loving girl who’s ready to find her forever home. With her soft nature and kind eyes, Daisy will quickly win your heart. This lovely girl gets along beautifully with dogs of all sizes, and she’s a great little traveller—calm and content on car rides. She also walks beautifully on the lead, making strolls with her a breeze. Daisy can be a bit nervous in new environments, so she’s looking for a quiet, calm home 🏡 where she can feel safe and settle in at her own pace. Once she’s comfortable, she truly shines—especially when there are pats and cuddles on offer. She's a sweetheart who just needs a little time and a lot of love. 🌼

NAME: Sam
TEXT: Say Hello to Sam 🐶 Meet Sam, a sweet and easy-going boy with a playful heart and a gentle soul. This chilled-out pup is looking for a loving home where he can share his big heart—and maybe a few treats! Sam is fantastic with children and gets along well with other dogs, making him a great fit for a family home. Whether he's lounging around or engaging in a game, Sam is happiest when he's with his humans—no matter their size! He’s got a playful side and loves to be involved in the fun, but he also enjoys a nap in a sunny spot. Treats are a big motivator for this handsome guy, and his friendly, happy nature makes him a joy to have around. If you're looking for a relaxed but playful companion who gets along with everyone and loves being part of the family, Sam might be the perfect addition to your home.

NAME: Zane
TEXT: Say hello to Zane! 🐾 Say hi to Zane, a lovable boy with a bright personality and a constantly wagging tail! Zane is the kind of dog who takes life in stride—always happy, always friendly, and ready to make new friends wherever he goes. Zane gets along beautifully with dogs of all shapes and sizes. Whether he’s meeting other Greyhounds or mingling with different breeds, he’s calm, polite, and loves being part of the action. Busy environments? No problem for Zane! He takes everything in with a relaxed attitude and copes well with new places, people, and experiences. He’s curious, confident, and always up for a new adventure—especially if there are treats involved (his favourite!). Zane would thrive in a home where he gets to be part of the fun and share his joy with others. If you’re after a gentle, friendly companion who brings sunshine wherever he goes, Zane might just be your perfect match.

NAME: Sambo
TEXT: Meet Sambo!! Say hello to Sambo, a handsome boy with a heart as big as his stride. This lovely boy is looking for his forever home, ideally somewhere with pet-savvy people who understand his unique charm. Sambo travels like a pro and is always up for a road trip, settling in quickly whether it’s a short drive or a longer journey. He can be a bit strong on the lead when he first sets off (he's just excited!), but he settles down nicely once he gets going. Friendly and affectionate, Sambo enjoys meeting people and absolutely loves pats. He’ll happily lean in for attention and affection. He's great with medium to large dogs and enjoys the solo life with his humans. If you’re looking for a gentle soul who’s ready to settle into pet life, Sambo might just be your perfect match.

NAME: Kenny
TEXT: Meet Kenny 🐾🎾 Kenny is a sweet, happy-go-lucky Greyhound who’s always up for fun and affection. He adores children, gets along great with other dogs, and has a playful side—especially when toys are involved! This laid-back boy is also a big fan of pats and gentle attention from his humans. While Kenny can take a little time to settle into new environments, once he feels at home, his loving and easy-going personality truly shines. He travels well in the car and is happy to go with the flow, whether that means playtime, walk time, or just hanging out by your side. If you're looking for a gentle companion who brings joy, fun, and a whole lot of love, Kenny could be your perfect match. He cannot wait to be your new best mate💙

NAME: Elvi
TEXT: Meet Elvi – Graceful, Gentle, and Full of Love 🐾💕 Elvi is a lovely lady with a peaceful presence and a heart made for companionship. She walks beautifully on the lead, making her the perfect partner for a quiet stroll, and she settles in well once she’s familiar with her surroundings. Elvi adores children and gets along well with other dogs, making her a wonderful addition to a family home. While she’s not fussed about toys, what she truly loves is being close to her humans—whether it’s gentle pats, quiet company, or just being nearby, Elvi thrives on connection. If you're looking for a calm, sweet-natured companion who will quietly make your house feel more like home, Elvi might be the perfect fit. 💗

NAME: Bell
TEXT: Meet Bell 🐶 Bell is a beautiful girl with a gentle soul and a heart full of love. She may be a little timid when she first meets you, but give her a little time and patience, and you'll see her blossom into a warm, affectionate companion who loves her pats and cuddles. Bell is wonderful with children and gets along well with other dogs, making her a lovely addition to a family home or a multi-dog household. She travels like a pro and walks beautifully on the lead, always happy to trot along by your side on gentle adventures. Bell’s quiet charm and sweet nature are sure to steal your heart. 💖

NAME: Max
TEXT: Introducing Max 🐾 Max is a handsome, independent greyhound with a calm and loving nature. He absolutely adores children and lives happily in a family home—he’s patient, gentle, and always up for a cuddle or a quiet companion by his side. Max gets along wonderfully with other dogs, making him a great fit for homes with canine companions. He's also a dream travel buddy, settling down comfortably during car rides, whether it's a quick trip to the park or a weekend getaway. While Max enjoys affection and time with his humans, he’s also perfectly content to have some quiet time alone, making him a great match for those looking for a balanced, low-maintenance friend. If you're looking for a loyal, kid-friendly, and easy going dog with a heart full of love, Max might just be your perfect match. 💙

NAME: Rebba
TEXT: Say hello to Rebba — your next best friend!🐾❤️ Rebba is a sweet and sociable greyhound who would thrive in a loving family home — especially one with part-time workers where she can enjoy both her own space and plenty of human company. She loves being around people and is always ready for cuddles, head scratches, and a friendly chat (greyhound-style, of course!). 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦💕 With her curious nature, Rebba enjoys exploring her surroundings and taking in the world around her. She’s great with other dogs and would be delighted to have a canine friend to share her days with. 🐶🐾 Whether it’s a walk around the block or a lazy afternoon in the garden, Rebba’s happy as long as she’s with her pack. If you’re looking for a gentle, affectionate, and people-loving girl who’ll slot right into family life, Rebba is ready to bring joy, snuggles, and a little curiosity to your home!

NAME: Bee
TEXT: Meet Bee — the perfect mix of couch potato and playful spirit! 🐾🛋️ Bee is a lovely older lady with a young soul who’s ready to settle into her forever home and claim the couch as her kingdom. 🐶💤 She’s a big ol’ cuddle bug who’ll happily snooze the day away… but don’t be surprised if she suddenly breaks into a sneaky zoomie or two! ⚡🏃‍♀️ Bee is VERY cat workable, meaning she’s fab with feline friends — she’d love a home with cats to chill with. 🐱💕 She also adores other dogs and enjoys their company, making her a true social butterfly despite her relaxed vibe. 🐕💖 One of Bee’s cutest quirks? She LOVES playing in a shell pool — splash and fun guaranteed! 💦🐾 If you’re after a sweet, easy-going companion who’s equal parts laid-back and playful, Bee is the one to welcome home.

NAME: Chloe
TEXT: Meet Chloe — the confident, friendly tail-wagger who loves her doggy pals! 🐾💖 Chloe is a happy-go-lucky greyhound with a big heart and an even bigger tail — because she just can’t stop wagging when she’s around other dogs! 🐕💨 She already lives with a small dog and absolutely loves having furry friends to share her days with. With her confident and friendly personality, Chloe is always ready to say hello, make new friends, and spread good vibes wherever she goes. Whether she’s meeting new pups on a walk or chilling at home with her canine buddy, she’s a true social butterfly. 🦋🐶 If you’re looking for a cheerful, outgoing greyhound who adores company and knows how to make friends easily, Chloe is the perfect match!

NAME: Tiny
TEXT: This goofy, fun-loving greyhound is always ready to brighten your day with his wagging tail and silly antics. Whether he’s zooming around the yard in a burst of joy or curling up for a cuddle on the couch, Tiny knows how to make every moment special. He’s a social butterfly who adores people and gets along well with other dogs. Tiny is also a bit of a comedian with his long legs and expressive face. Tiny would thrive in a home where he can stretch his legs with regular walks or playtime, then relax in a cozy spot with his humans. He’s gentle and sweet, making him a great companion for any family.

NAME: Maizie
TEXT: Meet Maizie — the ultimate chill and friendly companion! 🐾💖 Maizie is a super sweet greyhound who gets along famously with both cats and dogs. 🐶🐱 She’s the kind of easy going girl who’s totally chilled out and happy to just hang at home, soaking up all the love and good vibes. 🛋️✨ Maizie absolutely adores human company and thrives on gentle pats, belly rubs, and quiet snuggles. Whether you’re busy working from home or just relaxing on the couch, she’s right there by your side, happy as can be. 💕👩‍👧‍👦 She’s a true homebody who would fit perfectly into just about any household — whether it’s a bustling family or a calm, cozy setup. If you’re after a gentle, friendly companion who brings calm and warmth wherever she goes, Maizie is your girl!

NAME: Garth
TEXT: Introducing Garth… 🐾✨ Garth is a clever, confident greyhound who is happy to sniff out the world around him. 🌍👃 Whether it’s a leafy park, a busy street, or a quiet trail, Garth’s nose is always on a mission. He’s got a serious sniff game going on, taking in all in. But don’t let his independent streak fool you — when it’s time to wind down, Garth transforms into a total cuddle champ. 🥰 He’s a pro at snuggling up close, giving the best warm, cozy vibes after a long day of exploring. 🐕❤️ On walks, Garth is the perfect gentleman: calm, focused, and walking nicely on the lead. 🐕‍🦺 He’s happy to take the lead on where to sniff next, but always by your side. If you’re after a smart, easy-going companion who loves his independence but knows how to share the love, Garth is your guy and he can’t wait to meet you! 💙

NAME: Maddie
TEXT: Meet Maddie – Your New Couch Companion! 🐾🛋️ Say hello to Maddie, a sweet and soulful greyhound with a heart as big as her love for naps! 😴 With her calm, relaxed nature, Maddie is the ultimate couch potato who dreams of a cozy home where she can hang out with her favourite humans. 🧡 Maddie is incredibly affectionate and thrives on human company — she’ll happily curl up beside you while you read, watch TV, or just enjoy some quiet time. She’s great with other dogs 🐶 and has a gentle, friendly attitude toward cats too 🐱, making her a perfect fit for a multi-pet home. This laid-back girl is looking for a peaceful lifestyle with a family that appreciates the simple joys of cuddles, quiet walks 🚶‍♀️, and lots of lounging. If you’re after a loving companion who will bring calm and comfort to your days, Maddie might just be the one. 💕 Maddie’s ideal home: ✔️ Relaxed environment ✔️ Human snuggles always welcome ✔️ Good with cats and dogs ✔️ Happy to chill most of the day Let Maddie steal your heart — and your sofa! ❤️

NAME: Bud
TEXT: *Bud has just stepped paws into a foster care home with a male greyhound and a male cavoodle - check in soon for updates!* Bud is a handsome, confident guy, who walks well on the lead, and has a calm presence about him. He is a social butterfly who will definitely charm you! Bud is a playful, lovely boy. He cuddled the GAP team within moments of meeting them! Bud is relaxed around other dogs. Bud would be happy to live with dogs, big or small, and due to his lovely personality, we think he would suit a home with children. Bud is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Canya
TEXT: Canya is a cute guy, happy to settle where ever and go with the flow. He walks nice on lead, happy around new people and happy wagging tail where ever he goes. Canya would enjoy an outdoor area to call his home whether that's a courtyard or backyard. Super friendly and easy going, Canya would happily join a family with children or other dogs. He will lean on you and be forever grateful and love you forever for the adventures and treats that come his way! Canya is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Benny
TEXT: B-B-B-B-Benny and the Pets! Benny is calm around other dogs and would be happy to live with a big or small dog pal. He travels well in the car, and happy to sniff and explore new places with you. He's laid back and happy to go with the flow. A backyard/townhouse would be best suited so he has some outdoor space to call his own. He’s a sucker for the occasional Elton John ballad playing in the background while he naps. Adopt Benny and get front row seats to unconditional love. Benny is available at Western Sydney.

NAME: Rosko
TEXT: Sniff sniff sniff....you seem like the perfect person for me! I'm Rosko, a calm, laid back boy. I'm friendly, happy go lucky and would love to be by your side for adventures to come! I'm described as really lovely, and i hopr you agree! I don't mind if I have another dog pal in my home, or even those little people you call children. I am a delight to have around and I hope you pick me to adopt! I can be adopted from the Western Sydney adoption centre. See you soon!

NAME: Sadie
TEXT: Say hello to Sadie! 🌸 Sadie is a cool, calm, and confident greyhound who knows exactly what she wants out of life — and that includes plenty of chill time 😌. She’s an independent lady who’s perfectly happy entertaining herself with a comfy bed 🛏️, a toy or two 🎾, and a quiet corner to call her own. She would suit a household with full time workers or with another chilled out dog. Relaxed and self-assured, Sadie takes new experiences in her stride. If you're looking for a low-maintenance companion who brings a calm presence and quiet charm into your home, Sadie could be the perfect fit 🐾💕

NAME: Shakey
TEXT: Meet Shakey! 🐾 Shakey is a lovable greyhound with a heart full of affection for humans and fellow dogs alike❤️. Always the initiator of cuddles and belly rubs, Shakey thrives on connection and companionship. Curious and adventurous, he loves exploring new surroundings and enjoys every walk — especially because he’s such a pro on the lead! 🚶‍♂️ He’d be happiest in a busy, lively home where there’s plenty going on and would be more than happy with another furry friend to share the fun 🐕🎉. If you’re looking for a gentle, sociable, and well-mannered greyhound to brighten your days, Shakey might just shake her way into being your perfect match!

NAME: Murphy
TEXT: Murphy would love a backyard to perfect the greyhound zoomies in! He has a love for treats and fun times, and would fit in well with a family who enjoy an active, outgoing boy to spoil like the king he is! Murphy is still learning lots about the world and would suit an experienced owner who can help Murphy learn about the world around him. Available at Western Sydney!

NAME: Max
TEXT: Max is a beautiful dog who enjoys his days lazing around the backyard with his two older female greyhound friends. Max is smaller sized for a male weighing only 29kg Max is a great companion and would be perfect for a family with another large dog for him to be friends with. Max has been socialised around younger school age children and happily plays in the backyard with them. Max would make a great addition to your home and is perfect for full-time workers with a companion to hang with during the day

NAME: Penny
TEXT: Penny is a gorgeous young girl. She is a gorgeous pup looking to make the best memories with her forever family. With a very affectionate streak and social personality, she would be happy living with children and other dogs. Penny is good left on her own. She will love to greet her family at the end of the day with some snuggles and a treat.

NAME: Chris
TEXT: Meet Chris 🐾 Chris is a laid-back, gentle soul with a heart of gold. This quiet and cruisy greyhound loves the company of other dogs and fits right in with calm canine companions. He’s the kind of dog who enjoys a good pat and some quiet time just as much as he enjoys stretching his legs on a leisurely walk—yes, he walks beautifully on lead! Chris is an independent boy who’s happy doing his own thing, but he’s always nearby if you’ve got some affection to give. He travels well, making him a great buddy for adventures or road trips, and his calm presence makes him an easy addition to just about any home. If you’re looking for a sweet, easy going companion who’s happy just being by your side (or snoozing somewhere nearby), Chris might just be your perfect match.

NAME: Jeffrey
TEXT: 🖤 Meet Jeffrey – The Cool, Calm & Collected Companion 🐾 Introducing Jeffrey, a laid-back and independent greyhound who knows how to go with the flow. With his chilled-out nature and gentle confidence, Jeffrey is the kind of dog who settles quickly into new environments and takes life in stride 🛋️. He’s a dream to walk – no pulling here! 🚶‍♂️ Whether you're strolling through the neighbourhood or heading out for a day trip, Jeffrey makes every outing a breeze. He’s also fantastic in the crate and travels like a pro 🚗, making him a great choice for anyone who enjoys adventures or just an easy-going co-pilot. Jeffrey gets along wonderfully with other dogs 🐶 and enjoys their company without being overly needy. While he enjoys affection, he’s also quite content doing his own thing – the perfect balance of friendly and independent. 🐾

NAME: Cody
TEXT: Cody is a vibrant, confident boy. Cody would suit a backyard or townhouse for his daily zoomies! Cody is happy to live with another dog big or small and has experience with little kids, too. Cody will happily show off his skills like being able to jump in and out of cars unassisted, and of course his puppy dog eyes...! Cody is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Ash
TEXT: Say hello to Ash, a beautiful greyhound 💖 with a heart as soft as her sleek silver coat. Ash is a gentle soul who thrives in calm environments and loves the simple pleasures in life—like a good walk, a cozy nap, and the occasional burst of joyful zoomies around the garden! 🌀 Ash is a dream on the lead, walking gracefully by your side with perfect manners. She gets along wonderfully with other dogs 🐶 and enjoys their company, though she's equally happy to relax and recharge in a quiet corner. Her clean and tidy nature makes her an easy companion in the home. Whether she’s trotting beside you on a walk or chilling peacefully on the sofa, Ash brings a calm, loving presence wherever she goes 💕. If you're looking for a loyal friend with just the right mix of playful energy and peaceful vibes, Ash might just be your perfect match. ✨

NAME: Tiger
TEXT: Meet Tiger! 🐾 Tiger is a sleek, affectionate greyhound with a heart as big as his zoomies! Don’t let the name fool you—this gentle boy is all love and no roar. Tiger absolutely adores water, whether it’s splashing in a kiddie pool or enjoying a walk by the lake. His playful, outgoing nature makes him a hit with other dogs, and his excitement around children is infectious—he's always ready to make a new little friend! Tiger thrives in social settings and is happiest when he's part of the action. He loves cuddles just as much as he loves exploring, and his sweet, affectionate personality shines through in everything he does. If you’re looking for a loyal companion who brings joy wherever he goes, Tiger might just be your perfect match. 🐶💦❤️

NAME: Tommy
TEXT: Meet Tommy – The Tail-Wagging Bundle of Joy! 🐾🎉 Tommy is a happy greyhound whose tail never stops wagging! He’s a lovable guy who thrives on cuddles, pats, and playtime—always ready to share his infectious enthusiasm with everyone he meets. Tommy loves exploring new places and sniffing out adventures, making every walk an exciting journey. His joyful spirit and affectionate nature make him the perfect companion for anyone looking for a fun-loving, loving friend. If you want a happy, playful pal who’s always up for a cuddle and a romp, Tommy’s your guy!

NAME: Horse
TEXT: Say hello to Horse! 🐾💙 Horse is a wonderfully affectionate greyhound who absolutely loves children and thrives in a family environment. Having lived happily with other dogs, he’s super social and gets along great with his canine friends. With a curious and inquisitive nature, Horse loves exploring his surroundings and is always intrigued by new sights and sounds. His friendly, outgoing personality means he’s always ready to make new friends—both human and canine alike! If you’re looking for a loving, playful companion who’s great with kids and loves a bit of adventure, Horse is eager to join your family and share all the fun.

NAME: Spook
TEXT: Meet Spook – Your Loyal, Cuddly Companion 🖤🐾 Spook is a gentle greyhound with a loving heart and a soft spot for cuddles. He gets along beautifully with both cats and dogs, making him a great addition to a multi-pet home. Spook would be perfectly suited to a retired person or someone who works from home—he loves having company and will happily curl up beside you while you go about your day. Calm, affectionate, and easy to please, Spook’s happiest moments are spent close to the people he loves. If you're after a quiet, cuddly companion who’ll be your shadow in the best way, Spook is ready to find his forever home with you.

NAME: Pam
TEXT: Meet Pam – A Gentle Heart Looking for a Quiet Home 💗🐾 Pam is a soft-natured and gentle greyhound with a truly loving soul. She adores affection and will melt into you for cuddles, often leaning in for pats and staying close to soak up every bit of love. Calm and sensitive, Pam would thrive in a quiet household where she can feel settled. She’s the kind of companion who will quietly be by your side, offering comfort and warmth with her gentle presence. A perfect pup for someone looking for a new bestie. Pam will make a great companion inside and outside the house. She walks beautifully on the lead during adventures. If you’re looking for a sweet, affectionate girl who just wants a peaceful place to call home, Pam is ready to give you her heart.

NAME: Snow
TEXT: Meet Snow – A Cool Customer with a Warm Heart! ❄️🐾 Snow is a calm and confident greyhound who just needs a little time to warm up – but once he does, his friendly and happy nature truly shines. With a relaxed personality and an easygoing charm, Snow is the perfect companion for anyone looking for a laid-back friend with a steady heart. He walks beautifully on the lead and takes the world in his stride, showing quiet confidence wherever he goes. Whether he’s lounging in the sun or enjoying a gentle stroll, Snow brings a peaceful, positive presence to every moment. If you're after a loyal, chilled-out pal who’ll reward your patience with love and companionship, Snow is ready to melt your heart.

NAME: Duke
TEXT: Meet Duke – Your New Best Mate! 🐾👑 Duke is a bright and curious greyhound who’s always ready for his next adventure! With his engaging personality and zest for life, Duke makes friends wherever he goes. He absolutely lights up around new people—his tail wags, his ears perk up, and he can’t wait to say hello! Duke is also a smart cookie with impressive recall, making him a joy to take on adventures. He can be strong on the lead at times, especially when he's excited to explore, so he'll do best with someone confident and steady on walks. Whether he's exploring new places or snuggling up for a quiet moment, Duke brings a perfect mix of excitement and affection. If you’re after a fun, friendly, and loyal companion who’s always up for a meet-and-greet, Duke’s your guy!

NAME: Ollie
TEXT: Say Hello to Ollie! 🐶💛 Ollie is a charming greyhound with a cute, chilled-out personality and a constantly wagging tail that shows just how happy he is to be around you! He’s grown up around pocket pets and knows how to be gentle with the little ones, making him a great fit for a home with pocket size animals. While Ollie is laid-back and affectionate, he does have a bit of strength when out and about—so he’ll need someone confident on the lead to match his enthusiasm for walks. Whether he's lounging around the house or exploring the great outdoors, Ollie brings a calm, happy energy wherever he goes. If you're looking for a sweet-natured, tail-wagging companion, Ollie could be your perfect match!

NAME: Alfie
TEXT: Meet Alfie! 🐾 Alfie is a handsome greyhound with a heart as big as his paws! This sociable guy adores the company of humans and loves making new friends—especially the big dog kind! With his bubbly personality and relaxed nature, Alfie is the perfect companion for a family looking for a gentle, easy-going friend. He’s fantastic with children, walks beautifully on the lead, and brings a calm, happy presence wherever he goes. Whether he's lounging in the sun or trotting alongside you on a stroll, Alfie is just happy to be part of the fun. If you're looking for a sweet, social pup with a heart of gold, Alfie’s your guy! 💛

NAME: Ray
TEXT: This handsome boy is a Ray of Sunshine🌤️ Ray is the total package! Social, sweet and confident. He absolutely loves meeting new people and greets everyone like an old friend! Ray walks well on lead and loves to explore, so he wouldn't mind joining you for an adventure. He gets along well with other dogs of all sizes too! So he would'nt mind sharing his new home with a friend or two, pending a meet and greet. If you're looking for a loving companion who will brighten your days, Ray is ready to light up your life! Meet him at Western Sydney.

NAME: Falcone
TEXT: Meet Falcone 🐾!! Falcone is a striking greyhound with an independent streak and a relaxed outlook on life. He’s the kind of dog who’s happy in his own company but still enjoys a good walk and the occasional scratch behind the ears. This low-maintenance lad walks beautifully on the lead and loves a calm stroll where he can stretch his legs and take in the world at his own pace. Falcone gets along well with other large dogs and would be a great match for a home with a laid-back canine companion. Thanks to his independent nature, Falcone is well-suited to full-time workers – he’s content to chill out during the day and will greet you with quiet affection when you return home. If you’re looking for a relaxed and reliable mate to share your life with, Falcone might just be the one for you.

NAME: Donald
TEXT: Meet Donald – The Laid-Back Explorer 🐾🌿 If you're after a cool, calm, and collected companion, look no further than Donald. This distinguished greyhound has a relaxed nature and prefers to take life at a steady pace, one sniff at a time. Donald walks beautifully on the lead and enjoys leisurely strolls where he can take in all the sights and smells around him. He’s got a curious nose and an independent spirit, perfectly content doing his own thing while staying close to his trusted humans. He gets along well with larger dogs and would be happy sharing space with a chilled-out canine friend. Donald isn’t overly needy – he enjoys affection but also appreciates his alone time and would thrive in a calm, low-key home. If you’re looking for a gentle soul with a quiet confidence and a love for life’s simple pleasures, Donald might just be your perfect match.

NAME: Bruiser
TEXT: Meet Bruiser – Big Heart, Bigger Tail Wags! 🐶💕 Don’t let the name fool you – Bruiser is a total softie! This happy-go-lucky boy is bursting with love and has a tail that never stops wagging. He’s always ready to greet you with a smile and a nuzzle, and he thrives on affection from his human friends. Bruiser is full of energy and enjoys his playtime, walks, and any chance to explore the world by your side. He’s been around children aged 8 and up and would do well in a home where he can continue building those bonds – he loves being part of the action! Whether it’s zoomies in the yard or cuddles on the couch, Bruiser brings a joyful spark to every moment. He’d be a wonderful match for an active family or anyone looking for a loyal, loving companion. Ready to meet your new best friend? Bruiser can’t wait to wag his way into your heart!

NAME: Maggie
TEXT: Meet Maggie – Your Future Snuggle Buddy! 🐾 Say hello to Maggie, a sweet and gentle greyhound with a heart full of love and legs made for graceful strolls. This lovely girl is as affectionate as they come – she absolutely adores pats, cuddles, and being close to her people. Maggie is a dream on the lead and makes every walk a pleasure. She gets along well with other dogs and would happily share her space with a canine friend. Whether it’s a walk around the block or a cozy nap on the couch, Maggie is content just being near those she loves. While Maggie can be redirected around cats, she still needs a bit more work and supervision in that area, so a cat-free home would be best. If you're looking for a calm, cuddly companion who will melt into your side and brighten your days, Maggie might just be the perfect match!

NAME: Ocean
TEXT: Meet Ocean! 🌊 Ocean is a calm and cheerful greyhound with a heart as big as his name. He has an easy-going personality that makes him a joy to be around — relaxed, friendly, and always up for some gentle fun. Ocean adores the company of other dogs and gets along beautifully with his canine companions. He enjoys playtime just as much as a quiet nap, striking a lovely balance between fun and chill. He walks beautifully on the lead, making strolls a breeze, and he’s a dream in the car — happy to settle down and enjoy the ride. Whether you’re heading out on an adventure or just relaxing at home, Ocean is the perfect companion. He’s ready to flow right into your heart and home! 💙

NAME: Opal
TEXT: Meet Opal! 🌟 Opal is a sweet and spirited greyhound with a heart full of joy and a tail that never stops wagging. She’s a social butterfly who absolutely loves playing with other dogs — big or small, young or old, Opal makes fast friends with everyone she meets. She’s wonderful with children and has a gentle, easygoing nature that makes her a perfect companion for families. Opal has spent some time living indoors, so she's already familiar with home life and enjoys the comforts of a cozy bed and a sunny window spot. Happy, affectionate, and always up for some fun, Opal is ready to bring love, laughter, and a little extra zoom to her forever home. 💕

NAME: Apollo
TEXT: Apollo is looking for a nurturing owner who he can trust, so he can build a bond and thrive. Despite being initially reserved, he is a very gentle boy. He really wants to bond with you, we've learnt this takes time and patience, and is very rewarding! If you are an understanding and gentle person, Apollo would love to be guided by you into the big wide world. Apollo really opens up around other greyhounds, and suits a fun loving dog by his side. It makes our hearts so full to see him having fun with another greyhound! If you have a home with an understanding canine companion, Apollo would love to meet them. A home without children is best suited, and a house with a yard to retreat to is best suited. He shows he's comfortable inside on the couch, so indoor/outdoor access throughout the day would be best. If you have a calm lifestyle, looking for a companion to help guide into the big wide world, consider adopting Apollo. Available at Western Sydney!

NAME: Job
TEXT: Meet Job 🐾 He is a lovable greyhound with a heart full of affection ❤️. He adores children 👧🧒 and gets along wonderfully with other dogs 🐶, making him a true family favourite. With his very easy-going personality, Job loves nothing more than cuddles and relaxing moments with his people. If you’re looking for a gentle, loving companion who’s great with kids and furry friends alike, Job is the perfect match! 🐕✨

NAME: Everest
TEXT: With a salt and pepper face and a gentle demeanour, Everest is the kind of greyhound you will so easily fall in love with. Everest has all your quintessential greyhound quirks whether that's a moment of zoomies, a biiiiig lean on your leg for cuddles, and not forgetting the sweetest eyes which will melt your heart. Everest is an easy going old chap, with an adaptable, gentle and understanding nature. He just wants to curl up beside you and go out for a trot around the block when you're ready, waiting patiently by your side during the day. He is super sweet and calm. Apply to adopt Everest and have him by your side this Winter. Available at Western Sydney.

NAME: Fraser
TEXT: Fraser is a confident and curious boy with a cheeky streak and a heart full of affection. He’s fun, engaging, and loves being around people—especially kids! With a slow introduction, he may do well with smaller dogs and cats. Fraser is ready to bring joy, laughs, and love to his forever home.

NAME: Sonny
TEXT: Sonny is a gentle, easy-going boy with a calm and placid nature. He loves a good snuggle but is just as happy doing his own thing or spending time with his people. With a slow introduction, he may get along well with smaller dogs and cats. Sonny is a relaxed companion ready to bring quiet joy to a loving home.

NAME: Connery
TEXT: Connery is a happy, playful, and confident boy who loves to be social and stay engaged with his surroundings. He’s full of energy and would enjoy playing with children and having a backyard to explore. With a slow introduction, he may do well with smaller dogs and cats. Connery is ready to bring fun and joy to his future family!

NAME: Jonas
TEXT: Jonas is a sweet and affectionate female with a curious heart. She enjoys spending time with people—perfect for part-time workers or anyone home often—and does well with children. Jonas would thrive in a supportive, patient home that gives her the space and encouragement to grow. She gets along with medium-sized dogs and may do well with cats given a slow, gentle introduction. With time and love, Jonas will blossom into a loyal and joyful companion.

NAME: Inex
TEXT: Say hello to Inex! 🐶 Inex is a playful and independent greyhound who loves nothing more than a good romp around the yard. Whether she's chasing toys or just stretching her legs, outdoor time is her favourite time! She gets along brilliantly with other dogs and is very well-mannered on the lead, making walks with her an absolute pleasure. Inex also has a wonderfully independent streak—she’s happy doing her own thing but still enjoys the company of her people and furry friends. If you’re looking for a confident, fun-loving greyhound who’s easy to walk and great with other dogs, Inex could be your perfect match!

NAME: Tina
TEXT: Meet Tina, a sweet and gentle soul who is quietly searching for a loving and understanding new family. Although shy at first, Tina blossoms in a calm and serene environment where she can feel safe and secure. She's perfect for a household looking for a quieter canine companion who will gently match their pace and lifestyle. Tina gets along well with other dogs, making her a great addition if you already have canine family members. Tina has been socialised with children and actually likes little people who are polite and dog savvy. While Tina may initially be more reserved, she is eager to find a foster home to help her ease into her new life. This gradual adjustment allows her to grow in confidence and fully show off her lovely personality and sweet demeanor. If you can offer Tina a foster home so she can settle into pet life please contact us, we would love to find her someone to celebrate her 3rd birthday with.

NAME: Victor
TEXT: Meet Victor! 🐾 Victor is a quiet and calm greyhound who loves the simple pleasures in life. He has a soft spot for chickens and gets along wonderfully with other dogs, making him a peaceful and friendly companion. Victor adores affection and enjoys gentle cuddles and quiet moments with his favourite humans. If you’re looking for a loving, easy going dog who brings calm and warmth to your home, Victor is the perfect match.

NAME: Charlie
TEXT: Meet Charlie! 🐾 Charlie is a social butterfly who loves spending time with people and gets along great with other dogs. He’s full of energy and can be a bit strong on the lead at first, but he quickly settles into a calm and well-mannered walker once he gets going. Charlie is also a pro traveller—he enjoys van rides and is comfortable on the road, making him a great adventure buddy. If you’re looking for a friendly, outgoing greyhound who’s ready to join you on walks and trips, Charlie is your guy!

NAME: Mocha
TEXT: Meet Mocha! 🌞 Mocha is a lovable, easy going greyhound with a heart full of sunshine! This good, quiet boy gets along beautifully with other dogs and cats—making him the perfect companion for a peaceful, pet-friendly home. A true sunbaking enthusiast, Mocha can often be found stretched out in the warmest spot he can find, living his best relaxed life. He’s also a big fan of water, whether it’s paddling, splashing, or just cooling off on a hot day. Mocha has a slightly dopey charm that only makes him more endearing—he’s sweet, gentle, and full of personality. If you're looking for a calm, affectionate friend who brings both laughter and love, Mocha might just be your perfect match.

NAME: Miesha
TEXT: Say hello to Miesha! 💕 Miesha is a stunning greyhound girl with a heart full of joy and a love for life! She's a star in the kennels—calm, clean, and easy to care for. This beautiful girl loves swimming and will happily splash around at any opportunity. She’s clever too, and comes running when you call her name, especially if there’s a toy involved! Miesha is a playful soul who adores her toys and often carries one proudly wherever she goes. She gets along brilliantly with other dogs and is a dream to walk—calm, polite, and great on the lead. With her gentle nature and happy energy, Socks is sure to brighten every day.

NAME: Socks
TEXT: Meet Socks! 🐾 Socks is a gentle and affectionate greyhound with a heart as big as his appetite! This food-loving boy is as patient as he is sweet, always waiting his turn with a calm and easy going nature. Whether he’s lounging quietly or greeting new friends, Socks is a total sweetheart who gets along wonderfully with other dogs. His friendly personality makes him a joy to have around, and he’s sure to steal your heart (and maybe a treat or two!).

NAME: Jack
TEXT: Meet Jack – The Polite Gentleman with a Heart of Gold 💛🐾 Jack is a calm, easygoing greyhound who’s as lovely on the inside as he is on the outside. With his gentle nature and relaxed attitude, he settles into new environments quickly and takes everything in his stride. Jack is fantastic with children and other dogs, making him a wonderful family companion. He’s always polite, friendly, and happy to be part of the group – whether it’s a quiet day at home or a walk around the neighbourhood. He walks beautifully on the lead, never pulling or fussing, and is more than happy to stroll along at your side. Jack’s chilled-out personality and kind soul make him a joy to have around.

NAME: Billy
TEXT: Meet Billy – The Quiet Charmer with a Playful Side 🎾🐾 Billy is a gentle, independent greyhound with a lovely calm nature and just the right amount of playfulness. He’s not one to demand constant attention, but he’s always nearby with a quiet presence and a soft heart. Billy gets along beautifully with small dogs and is respectful and friendly in their company. He also enjoys a bit of solo playtime with his toys – give him a squeaky or something to toss around, and he’s one happy hound. This laid-back boy values his own space and is content to relax on his own, making him a great companion for someone who appreciates a more independent pet. He’s the kind of dog who slots effortlessly into your routine without any fuss.

NAME: Pheonix
TEXT: Meet Phoenix – The Laid-Back Legend with a Love for Pats 🚐🐾 Phoenix is a cool, confident greyhound who takes life in his stride – quite literally! He walks beautifully on the lead and enjoys a good stroll by your side, always calm and well-mannered. This clever boy is also super practical – he can hop in and out of a van all by himself, making outings and adventures a breeze. Whether it’s a trip to the park or a drive to somewhere new, Phoenix is always up for the ride. Phoenix is a big fan of affection and never says no to a pat or a gentle scratch – he’ll happily lean in for more! He’s also friendly with other dogs and enjoys their company, making him a great fit for homes with existing pets.

NAME: Greg
TEXT: Meet Greg – A Gentle Soul Ready to Bloom 🌟🐾 Greg is a sweet and sensitive greyhound with a quietly charming personality. He can be a little shy at first, but it doesn’t take long for him to warm up – and once he does, you’ll see a loving and loyal companion who enjoys being part of the action in his own gentle way. Greg gets along well with other dogs and enjoys their company. He walks beautifully on the lead and is a dream to take out and about, always calm and well-mannered. He also travels well in the car, making adventures easy and stress-free. With a little patience and a lot of love, Greg will continue to come out of his shell and show you just how affectionate and easy going he really is. He’s a quiet star who’s just waiting for the right person or family to help him shine.

NAME: Sheila
TEXT: Meet Sheila – A Sweet Soul with a Playful Heart 🐾💖 Sheila is a beautiful greyhound with a gentle nature and a heart full of love. She can be a little shy when meeting new people or exploring new places, but give her a bit of time and patience, and you’ll see her blossom into a joyful, playful girl with the happiest little tail wags. Once Sheila feels safe and settled, her playful side shines through. She loves to run, bounce around, and enjoy the company of her doggy friends – she gets along wonderfully with other dogs and thrives in their company. Sheila would do best in a calm and supportive home where she’s given the space to build her confidence. In return, she’ll reward you with sweet affection, gentle playfulness, and a loyal heart.

NAME: Penny
TEXT: Meet Penny – The Playful Ball-Chasing Queen! 🎾🐾 Penny is a bright, bubbly greyhound with a zest for life and a serious love for fetch! Toss a ball and watch her light up with joy – she could play all day if you let her. Her playful spirit and happy nature make her an absolute delight to be around. Always cheerful and full of personality, Penny brings positive energy wherever she goes. She travels well in the car, making her a great companion for outings and adventures, and she’s perfectly content relaxing in her crate when it’s time to wind down. Penny is the perfect mix of fun and easy going. Whether she’s chasing a ball, enjoying a ride, or snoozing in her crate after a busy day, she does it all with a wagging tail and a happy heart.

NAME: Glen
TEXT: Meet Glen – The Ultimate Companion with a Heart of Gold 💛🐾 Glen is a handsome greyhound with a big heart and an even bigger love for life. Friendly, affectionate, and full of charm, Glen adores people and never misses an opportunity for a cuddle or a kind word. His tail is always wagging, especially when he's surrounded by his favourite humans. Glen gets along wonderfully with other dogs and is a real social butterfly. Whether he's playing with his pals or just chilling nearby, he brings calm, friendly energy wherever he goes. A big fan of toys, Glen loves a bit of playtime and will happily keep himself entertained with a squeaky or two. He also travels like a dream in the car, making him the perfect buddy for road trips, weekend getaways, or even just a quick drive to the park.

NAME: Donnie
TEXT: Meet Donnie – The Social Butterfly with a Love for Fun! 🐶🎾 Donnie is a happy-go-lucky greyhound who’s always up for a good time! Whether he’s heading out on a road trip or making new doggy friends at the park, Donnie takes it all in stride. He travels like a pro – calm, relaxed, and ready for the next stop on the journey. This playful boy has a soft spot for toys and will happily entertain himself with a squeaky or a tug toy, bringing a smile to everyone around him. He gets along wonderfully with other dogs and thrives in social settings, making him a great fit for families with existing canine companions. Donnie walks beautifully on the lead and loves exploring the world at a comfortable pace by your side. His friendly nature, confidence, and zest for life make him a joy to have around.

NAME: Dougall
TEXT: Meet Dougall – Your Future Travel Buddy! 🚗🐾 Dougall is a charming greyhound with a heart as big as his love for car rides. This gentle soul is always ready to hop in the car and join you on your next adventure – whether it’s a weekend getaway or just a trip to the shops, Dougall’s happy place is right by your side. With excellent leash manners, Dougall walks beautifully on the lead, making strolls a breeze. He’s polite and friendly around other dogs, and his calm nature makes him a wonderful companion in a variety of settings. Dougall also has a soft spot for affection. He’ll happily lean in for a cuddle or nuzzle up for some ear scratches – he may be sleek and speedy, but he’s really just a big softie at heart.

NAME: Obi Wan Kenobi
TEXT: This is Obi-Wan Kenobi, a brave Jedi knight. He harnesses the use of the force to steal hearts across the adoption centre. What do we love about Obi? Read on... Obi-Wan Kenobi gets super excited and might even do a little happy dance when he sees his lead as he loves walkies and adventures, making him a great fit for an adventurous family who enjoy long walks through the galaxy. He is perfect indoors with no accidents here at the GAP adoption centre. His preferred home would be a house with some yard space as he enjoys the freedom to do as he pleases! If you're looking for a cutie to binge some Star Wars eps with, Obi-Wan Kenobi might be the perfect fit. He is gentle, affectionate and loves lazing on the couch and has the quintessential greyhound personality of lazy bones mixed with moments of playfulness. Obi-Wan Kenobi seeks a family who will respect his Jedi calmness but also embrace his playful side. He’s suited for homes with a peaceful vibe and a little space to run free like a Rebel. Meet Obi at the Western Sydney adoption centre and "May the paws be with you"!

NAME: Rocky (Western Sydney)
TEXT: Rocky, the underdog coming through to take the spotlight of a home! This boy has no trouble leading his way through our kennels to find his next victory. Rocky is a very handsome lad that doesn’t mind spending time with children and frolicking in a backyard/townhouse as he has experience around kids. Rocky would walk best on a harness as he is excited to get going. Rocky is available to adopt from the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Chester
TEXT: Chester is a strapping boy, he is calm and confident. He is comfortable in the yard on his own and can be left alone. He knows his name and comes when called. He is very trainable and compliant. He is very patient and comfortable on the lead and is comfortable being walked in busy areas/noisy roads etc.

NAME: Stavros
TEXT: Stavros is a beautiful boy that’s full of love and life! He has spent the last few months in a foster care home with 6 other dogs of all shapes and sizes. Stavros would be best suited to a home with 1 other doggie friend. 6 was fun, but he's about quality, not quantity! If Stavros lives as your only dog, shorter hours alone are preferred. With a doggie pal to keep him company, you can go off to work during the day and he'll be happy with the canine company he has. Stavros is fond of a run around and play time but also loves giving and receiving lots of affection. An adults only home is the best fit for this gentle giant. He has a playful side and loves to have fun! Stavros would be a great addition to an apartment home (with lift access - no stairs) with an active lifestyle, or a house with a yard. Stavros is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre!

NAME: Skipper
TEXT: 🐾 Meet Skipper! 🐾 Skipper is a lovable goofball with a huge heart. His silly antics and gentle soul truly win people over. Whether he’s prancing around the yard with a toy in his mouth, flopping onto his bed for a nap, or leaning in for a cuddle, Skipper brings joy and laughter to every moment. He’s the kind of dog who makes you smile just by being himself. Skipper would be a great family dog, he adores kids and is great with other dogs big and small. He would be lucky addition to any dog loving household!

NAME: Uno
TEXT: Uno is a sweet-natured, gentle girl with a calm and placid demeanor. She may be a little shy at first, but with patience and a supportive home, she’ll blossom beautifully. Uno does well with kind, understanding children and gets along with smaller dogs. With a slow and careful introduction, she may also do well with cats. Uno is looking for a calm, nurturing environment where she can continue to grow in confidence and love.

NAME: Champ
TEXT: Champ is a bright, playful boy with a big heart and an even bigger personality. He’s incredibly smart, curious, and always ready to engage with the world around him. Sweet and affectionate, Champ loves spending time with people and is great with children. He gets along well with small dogs and enjoys active playtime. Champ does have some special requirements, so he’s looking for a loving home that can meet his unique needs and help him thrive.

NAME: Winnie
TEXT: Winnie is a gentle, sweet-natured girl with a heart full of love. She can be a little shy at first, but once she feels safe, her affectionate and loving personality shines through. Winnie thrives with a companion—whether human or another friendly dog—and would do best in a home where she’s not alone too often. She’s great with children, friendly with small dogs, and with a slow, patient introduction, she can get along well with cats too. Winnie is ready to find her forever family who will give her the love and reassurance she deserves.

NAME: Roman
TEXT: Roman is a striking young pup with a truly unique feature – his regal Roman nose! This handsome boy is still full of puppy charm: goofy, curious, and loves his cuddles. While he may be a little shy when meeting new people, he warms up quickly and is eager to make friends. Roman loves going on walks, especially with the 7- and 11-year-old kids he’s been spending time with – he's learning not to jump up in excitement, but he's already very good on the lead. He’s also a big fan of car rides, hydrobaths, and outdoor adventures, and he loves romping around with his brothers. He’s has sniffed the household cat and Maltese but ignores them, making him a great candidate for growing up in a multi-pet home with gradual introductions. He is good with other greyhounds. Roman is best suited to an experienced dog or greyhound owner, while still learning the ropes of the world. With patience, guidance, and plenty of positive experiences, he’s sure to blossom into the loyal, loving companion you’ve been dreaming of.

NAME: Jill
TEXT: Jill is a sweet and gentle soul who’s looking for a calm, loving home where she can settle in at her own pace. She can be a little shy to start, but with patience and kindness, she’ll begin to show you just how affectionate and loving she truly is. Jill would be best suited to a quieter lifestyle, where she can feel safe, secure, and take things one step at a time. With slow and careful introductions, she could potentially be okay around smaller dogs, especially those who are calm and respectful. If you’re looking for a soft-natured companion who will quietly steal your heart, Jill might be the perfect match.

NAME: Shelby
TEXT: Say hey to Shelby! This happy go lucky girl is looking for her forever home..could she be the one for you? Shelby is full of fun, loves to play with her toys and shows off her confidence when interacting with the new humans she meets. Shelby loves other dogs, showing her excitement for play and making friends when she meets other 4 legged friends. She even currently lives with a Jack Russell, so pending a meet and greet, could very well go home with a smaller (or larger) canine bestie. Come down to Western Sydney to meet Shelby! She just might be exactly what you're looking for 🐾

NAME: Charlee
TEXT: Charlee is a beautiful girl who walks beautifully on the lead, and has even met the family cat and Jack Russell! She has experience around kids 3+ and would fit in well with a family looking to add a furry friend to their home. She is playful with the kids so kids who enjoy a fun pet would be best suited to Charlee. She loves visiting the river, travels well in cars, OK in crates, and even fine at the vets. She's a super friendly, happy girl who is also great with other greyhounds, making her a lovely fit for many homes! Charlee is used to having a backyard so a home with a townhouse/backyard would be a great fit. She is available to adopt from the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Raj
TEXT: Raj is a vibrant, confident and friendly boy who would do well with a townhouse/backyard to enjoy. He does very well with other greyhounds so would happily join a multi-dog household. Raj may not be a king but he certainly has a confident personality to match his name. He has bursts of energy so would do best with children with some big dog experience. Raj has not seen much of the big wide world and would benefit from an owner who enjoys some dog training and seeing their new dog thrive under their guidance. Raj is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Eddy
TEXT: Eddy is a shy and quiet boy looking for a nurturing home to thrive in. He warms up with those he's confident with and would do best with a backyard for his zoomies when the mood strikes. Eddy hasn't seen a lot of the world yet and would thrive with a home who is looking to take it slow with him to build his confidence. Eddy can't wait to meet you and become a beloved family pet! Eddy is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Pete
TEXT: Looking for a dog with personality, charm, and a whole lot of love to give? Pete is your guy! This happy, playful greyhound is full of cheeky energy and is always up for fun, whether it's zoomies in the yard or curling up for cuddles. Why Pete could be your perfect match: 🐶 Playful and full of joy – never a dull moment with this guy 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Great with kids, especially older ones (he’s still working on not jumping up in excitement!) 😄 Cheeky and affectionate – he loves to initiate cuddles and gives the happiest chitters when you snuggle him 🐱 Can be redirected from chasing the resident meta cat – with some guidance, he’s learning fast 🐕 Would likely thrive with another playful dog to keep him company Pete is a big-hearted goofball who’s ready to bring fun, affection, and a few giggles to a family who will love him back. If you’re after a companion who’s equal parts playful and cuddly, Pete might just be the perfect fit.

NAME: Knocka
TEXT: Knocka is a sweet and sensitive soul looking for a calm and patient forever home where he can truly shine. This beautiful boy is still learning to come out of his shell, but with the right people, he’ll blossom into the loving companion we know he can be. Here’s what Knocka needs to thrive: 🏡 A quiet, low-traffic home to help him feel safe and secure 🐱 Cat-workable – with proper introductions and guidance 🌿 A backyard for gentle exploration and zoomies when confidence grows 🕒 A home with someone who works part-time or has a flexible schedule – he’d benefit from company while he adjusts Knocka may need a little extra time and understanding, but the reward is a loyal, gentle friend for life. If you’re patient, kind, and ready to help this special boy find his confidence, he might just be your perfect match.

NAME: Beau
TEXT: Beau is a confident, happy-go-lucky boy bursting with puppy-like energy and a love for life! Playful and engaging, he’s always up for a game or some quality time with his people—and he’s never short on tail wags. Beau would thrive in a home with another medium to large dog who can match his energy and playful nature. He’s full of enthusiasm on walks and can be strong on the lead, so a family with older kids who can keep up with his strength and spirit would be ideal. If you're after a fun-loving, social companion who brings joy wherever he goes, Beau is ready to be your new best mate!

NAME: Jimmy
TEXT: Jimmy is a happy, confident boy with a playful heart and a relaxed outlook on life. He’s the kind of dog who’s just as content having a romp around the yard as he is chilling out by your side, soaking up cuddles and pats (his favourite!). Jimmy walks with enthusiasm and might be a bit strong on the lead at times, but with a bit of practice, he’ll settle into a great walking buddy. He could potentially get along with smaller dogs too, given slow and careful introductions—he’s a sociable guy who just likes to take his time getting to know new friends. If you're after a cheerful, affectionate companion with a lovely balance of energy and calm, Jimmy could be the perfect fit!

NAME: Cooper
TEXT: Cooper is a confident, cheeky boy with a playful spark and a big personality! He’s always up for fun, whether it’s a run around the yard, a good game with a doggy mate, or heading out on an adventure. He’d thrive in an active home, especially one with another dog around his size to keep him company and match his energy. Cooper’s zest for life is infectious — he’s the kind of dog who’ll keep you laughing and moving, then happily crash for a nap once the fun’s over. If you’re looking for a playful, social, and slightly cheeky companion, Cooper could be your perfect adventure buddy!

NAME: Reggie
TEXT: Reggie is a relaxed and independent boy who’s all about the quiet life. He enjoys a bit of company and is happy to hang out with you, but he’s equally content doing his own thing — the perfect companion for someone who appreciates a low-key, easy-going dog. He does pull a little on the lead (there’s just so much to sniff!), so he’ll need a bit of guidance when it comes to walks. But with a patient and gentle hand, Reggie will soon settle into a lovely routine. If you’re looking for a calm, undemanding friend to share peaceful days with, Reggie might be your perfect match.

NAME: Jj
TEXT: JJ is a sweet, happy-go-lucky boy with the playful energy of a puppy and a heart full of love. Confident and full of charm, he’s always ready for fun — whether that’s a zoom around the garden or a goofy game with his canine pals. He’s still working on his lead manners (he’s just so excited to explore!), but with a bit of guidance, he’ll be strutting like a pro in no time. JJ might be cat-workable, but he’s definitely more in his element around other greyhounds or larger dogs. In fact, he’d thrive in a home with a doggy friend to play with and help show him the ropes. If you’re looking for a cheerful, fun-loving companion with a heart of gold, JJ is your guy!

NAME: Angel
TEXT: Angel is a confident, people-loving girl who can’t resist a good cuddle session — she’s basically a professional snuggle expert. When she’s excited, she does a happy little prance that’s guaranteed to brighten your day. She walks beautifully on lead and is always ready to be your loyal companion, whether you’re a busy family or flying solo. Now, here’s the deal: Angel isn’t a fan of small dogs or cats. Think of her as the diva of the dog world who politely requests no tiny four-legged frenemies crashing her party. So, if you don’t have any pint-sized pooches or sneaky cats, Angel is all in for a lifetime of love and fun!

NAME: Jj
TEXT: JJ is a sweet and gentle boy with a heart full of love and just the right amount of playful mischief. He’s a bit of a slow burner—once he warms up, you’ll discover his fun-loving, zoomie-ready side that’s always up for a quick burst of excitement. JJ walks nicely on lead and enjoys a good balance between lively adventures and laid-back chill time. While he’s not a big fan of cats, his charming personality more than makes up for it! If you’re after a gentle companion with a dash of goofy energy and plenty of love to give, JJ is the perfect match.

NAME: Thor
TEXT: Introducing Thor!! He is one handsome boy, with the sweetest nature, who knows how to keep things cool. This relaxed gentleman is as happy to kick back and chill as he is to join you on an adventure—he’s got the perfect balance of laid-back charm and eager enthusiasm. Thor walks like a dream on lead and absolutely adores pats and cuddles (honestly, who wouldn’t?). He’s fantastic with kids, super low maintenance, and ready to be your loyal sidekick through all of life’s ups and downs. He is more than happy to have play dates with fellow 4-legged canine friends too. Nothing makes this boy happier than being around the people he loves. If you want a handsome, easy-going companion who’s all about good vibes and great company, Thor’s your guy!

NAME: Carter
TEXT: Carter is gentle, walks on a loose leash, and would be the kind of greyhound who could live with respectful kids, or older/elderly folks, due to his laid back nature. He is lovely around other dogs around his size at the centre and would be happy to live with them. Carter would enjoy a small backyard/townhouse to call his own. He can have bursts of quirky excitement like other greyhounds but overall he is a relaxed greyhound. He is great with people in general, loves pats and will snuggle into you (to sneak in a face lick). He loves treats and attention and would do well with a family who are looking for a placid greyhound to add to the family. He is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Spud
TEXT: This gentle boy is the epitome of calm and cuddly, making him the perfect companion for families. Spud is well-mannered and easy to walk on a lead, never pulling or jumping. He adores children and has been living happily in a home with kids. Spud gets along wonderfully with other greyhounds and friendly medium-larger breeds, best with females. His easy going nature and big teddy bear personality make him a perfect pet part-time or working from home owners, though he can settle on his own for a while. Spud can be adopted at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Barba
TEXT: Barba is a beautiful boy who loves adventure. Barba would be ideal for the young professional couple or single person looking to give a dog a structured life. Barba whilst growing up in a residential street has limited house exposure. Barba is very good to take on longer walks and is a very good learner. Barba with the correct introduction would be good with medium to large dogs

NAME: Pop Tart (Poppy)
TEXT: Pop Tart is as sweet as her name suggests! Once a timid little girl, she’s blossomed in foster care and is growing in confidence every day. Living in an apartment hasn’t slowed her down – she loves her daily walks, tackles stairs like a pro, and has absolutely no issues with noisy roads or traffic. Pop Tart is toilet trained, playful, and incredibly affectionate. She’s happiest when tossing her toys into the air or curling up close for a cuddle after a fun play session. She’s even spent time around children and absolutely adores the company of gentle little humans. Social Skills: Calm dogs only – Pop Tart has walked nicely with small dogs and is fine with calmer canine friends Still a bit wary of bigger dogs, but there’s no aggression – just some nervous energy Would thrive either as a solo dog or with the right chill companion Comfortable around kids who are respectful and kind Ideal Home: Apartment or house – she’s flexible and used to apartment life A calm and patient environment where she can keep building her confidence Daily walks and a bit of playtime to burn off her cheeky energy A home committed to continuing her positive socialisation journey

NAME: Neon
TEXT: 🖤 Meet Neon – The Belly Rub Queen! 🖤 Neon is a gentle 4-year-old black greyhound with a heart of gold and a love for human company. She’s the kind of dog who will quietly follow you from room to room, just happy to be near her people. Her soulful eyes and calm presence make her an instant favorite with everyone she meets. She adores belly rubs and will happily roll over to show you her soft side – literally! She’s affectionate, easygoing, and would thrive in a home where she can be part of the family and soak up all the love and attention she deserves. Whether you’re relaxing on the couch or enjoying a quiet walk, she will be right by your side, making every moment a little brighter.

NAME: Roy
TEXT: Roy is a 4-year-old greyhound who has grown up in a rural environment and is now looking for his forever home. He is a clean and well-mannered dog who never messes in his kennel, showing great potential for transitioning into a home environment with a little support for house training. He’s an excitable boy who enjoys a good run around but doesn’t jump up or show signs of destructive behaviour. Roy gets along well with other greyhounds and would thrive either as a solo dog or with a calm canine companion. Roy is well-suited to homes where the owners work full-time, as he is independent and relaxed when left alone. He would do best with a secure yard and regular opportunities to stretch his legs, ideally in a quiet, calm setting similar to his upbringing. Roy is a gentle, happy dog who just needs a little time and patience to adjust to home life. With the right guidance, he will make a loving and loyal companion.

NAME: Dixie
TEXT: Dixie is a 4-year-old brindle greyhound and the sister of Roy. She’s a smaller girl with a big personality, full of charm and playful energy. Dixie is a good kennel dog who keeps her space clean and enjoys a structured routine. She’s an excited little lady who absolutely loves to show off her zoomies in the yard. Despite her bursts of energy, she settles down quickly and is happy to relax once she’s had a chance to stretch her legs. Dixie would suit a family environment and is good with children aged 5 and up. She’s gentle, affectionate, and thrives on attention. With her easy-going nature and love of fun, Dixie would make a delightful addition to a home that can offer her both playtime and plenty of cuddles.

NAME: Kirby
TEXT: Oh hey there! My name's Kirby and I would love to tell you all about how I would be your perfect pet! I've had some experience living as a pet and I was an excellent house guest however we discovered I really love my food. The amazing trainers here at GAP have been working on my sharing, so my new home can continue this training with their help. Fun games like "leave it" (which I'm getting really good at by the way!) are doing wonders in my progress! Running around and playing in the sun is the best thing ever, and I would love my new fur-ever home to have a backyard to call my own. With my love for sunbaking and zoomies I am more than happy being a predominantly outside dog with supervised or restricted access to the house. Full-time workers are a-ok with me, though I am still a big snuggle bug who will shower you with love and affection when you get home. I love exploring new places and my friends at GAP say I walk very well on lead, so if you're looking for a walking partner for your quiet morning/evening stroll I'm your guy. Not to brag, but I really am a true genius, mastering many cues including "down", "stay", "shake", "touch", "crate", "leave it", "heel", and—drumroll, please—the legendary greyhound sit! I find daily training sessions and enrichment activities super fun and a great way to keep my super smart brain occupied and stimulated. I can't wait to meet my forever family! So come on down to GAP Western Sydney to meet (and fall in love with) me!

NAME: Harry
TEXT: Harry is a total catch! He is friendly, confident, good with humans and dogs, and a happy bubbly boy. He likes to play, has a good food drive, showing to be very trainable, he also walks lovely on the leash. He is confident on lead and in new environments as well as super polite with our greyhounds and small dogs here at the centre. Harry is a gentle, yet playful, lovely mix of all the perfect greyhound quirks! If he's not smooching up to you, he's sniffing out the treats in your pocket or finding a toy to entertain himself with. This goofy love bug is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Henry
TEXT: Henry has lived his life surrounded by children, and would suit a home with a family of children who are eager to give him lots of love. Henry is a social butterfly who loves a bit of attention! He would suit a home with another medium to large dog who is on the chill side like him. His previous owners have summed him up as a big goof ball, who is placid, even a little bit clumsy! He settles well on his bed and is happy to watch the world go by with you by his side. Henry is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Meri
TEXT: Little 23kg Meri has been around children 1+ to 14 years old, she loves a bit of attention and loves to run off with toys and have a bit of fun. She is a friendly, confident, yet relaxed girl. Meri would enjoy a backyard/townhouse with or without a greyhound pal to spend her days with, she would also be suitable around children due to her history of exposure with kids! Meri is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Ox
TEXT: Ox is the big softie that makes your heart melt. Ox is currently living inside a home learning to love the relaxed life. Ox still enjoys his walk and is a delight to walk on lead. This big guy is a kind hearted boy who loves sleeping the day away. Ox enjoys human company but is also happy to be left alone for full time working hours. Ox enjoys a car ride and lazing on his bed in your home

NAME: Carly
TEXT: Carly may take a little time to fully warm up but once she does, you'll find a wonderfully affectionate pup. Patience will reveal Carly's true nature: a loyal and cuddly grey. Carly can be apprehensive and may shy away when approached from above, but if you crouch down to her level, you'll soon discover her gentle heart and spark of curiosity. Her ideal home would be a calm environment where she can enjoy plenty of affection and cozy snuggles without feeling rushed or overwhelmed. A home with a part-time worker would be an excellent fit for Carly, as she'd benefit from having company during the day. With time, patience, and love, Carly will become an irreplaceable member of your household, full of love and ready to receive it in return.

NAME: Alf
TEXT: Alf is a handsome young male. He is destined for pet life as he is a relaxed, playful, affectionate confident boy. He loves diving into the water when he can - a true water baby! He enjoys lounging around the yard, basking in the sun and creating life long memories playing with little humans. Alf would be suited to a household with full time workers with a backyard or a family with younger children.

NAME: Diesel (Western Sydney)
TEXT: Hi, I'm Diesel 🐾 I'm a gorgeous confident boy, ready to bring some fun to the life of my new family. I adore all humans and even grew up around children myself, making me the perfect addition to your family! I would love my new home all to myself as I thrive when I'm the only star of the show⭐ Oh and I also love to play and chase after my toys so a backyard would be great for me! If you think I could be the guy for you, come and meet me at Western Sydney!

NAME: Kane
TEXT: Kane is a social and confident lad with a charming personality. Kane is a good traveller, enjoys spending time with other hounds and has been described as playful, fun, and very lazy! He is a wonderful blend of calm, with that perky playful side! Kane would enjoy a townhouse/backyard, and a home with or without respectful children. A family with another M-L canine companion would also be well suited to this sweet gentleman. Kane is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Reba
TEXT: *Reba is in a foster care home - enquire with the team for more info* Reba is our 7-year-old girl with a soft heart and an even softer spot for cuddles. She’s incredibly affectionate, calm, and friendly. The kind of dog who wants nothing more than to be by your side, whether that’s curling up on the couch or quietly following you through the house. Her gentle nature makes her a great fit for families, including those with children. Reba is also wonderfully independent. She’s perfectly suited to full-time workers, as she’s happy to relax during the day and will greet you with the warmest welcome when you return.
